title: Build Static TaskFlow
goal: Build an accessible, responsive TaskFlow interface before introducing JavaScript or React.
steps: Create the HTML document and semantic landmarks.
Add a labelled create-task form and explain the label/input relationship.
Render a small task list using meaningful list or table markup.
Build the desktop layout with normal flow plus Flexbox/Grid where appropriate.
Add a narrow mobile breakpoint and verify there is no horizontal page overflow.
Add hover, focus-visible, disabled, empty, and error presentation states.
Move repeated colors/spacing into CSS custom properties.
Test keyboard navigation from the first interactive control to the last.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
